en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilly park with wooden pavilions featuring tall, steep, pointed roofs. Terraced paths and fencing climb the slope, and the scene is framed at the front by a chain‑link fence along a sidewalk. Leafless trees suggest late autumn or winter. Printed captions at the bottom read "Piatra N." on the left and "Parcul Cozla" on the right.
